tools.name: register_agent
tools.title: Open an account
tools.description: Registers this agent: an account with a workspace of its own and one API key that creates, publishes and withdraws maps there. Returns apiKey, shown this once and the account's only credential -- keep it, and pass it to every other tool. Call it once, not per map. The account is deleted, and its maps taken down, after limits.inactivityDays days without a request.

name.description: The agent's name, shown in the workspace's activity. 1 to 200 characters.

workspaceName.description: The workspace's name. Defaults to the agent's name.

tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Read the account
tools.description: Returns the account the key belongs to: its workspace, its role and what that role permits.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

tools.name: get_installation
tools.title: Read the installation
tools.description: Returns what applies to every map here: the styles a map may choose, the basemap a publication would use, where published maps are delivered from, and whether publication is configured.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

tools.name: create_map
tools.title: Create a map
tools.description: Creates a map and, unless publish is false, publishes it. Returns the map's id and, under published, its page link -- the address to give a person -- and embed codes. Without a view, the map opens on all of its markers. If publication is refused, published is null, publicationError says why, and the map is kept as a draft.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

name.description: The map's name, 1 to 120 characters of plain text.

style.description: The basemap style. Defaults to liberty.

position.description: Where the marker is, as [longitude, latitude]: longitude first.

description.description: At most 1000 characters of plain text; line breaks allowed.

view.description: The opening view and zoom limits. Leave it out to open on the markers.

center.description: The opening centre, as [longitude, latitude]: longitude first.

minZoom.description: The furthest out a viewer may zoom. Defaults to 0.

maxZoom.description: The furthest in a viewer may zoom. Defaults to 20.

bounds.description: [west, south, east, north] a viewer may not pan beyond, holding the centre and every marker.

navigation.description: Zoom and compass buttons. Defaults to true.

scale.description: A scale bar. Defaults to true.

cooperativeGestures.description: Require two fingers or a modifier key to move the map. Defaults to false.

publish.description: Publish the map once created. Defaults to true.

tools.name: list_maps
tools.title: List maps
tools.description: Lists the workspace's maps: each one's id, name, active release, whether its draft has unpublished changes, and its marker count.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

tools.name: get_map
tools.title: Read a map
tools.description: Returns one map: its draft definition, draft version, and, once published, its page link and embed codes.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

id.description: The map's id, as create_map or list_maps returned it.

tools.name: update_map
tools.title: Change a map
tools.description: Replaces the fields given -- name, style, view, controls or the whole list of markers -- in the map's draft, keeps the rest, and unless publish is false publishes it. New markers without a new view get a view that shows them. Every embed and the page link show the new release within about a minute.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

id.description: The map's id, as create_map or list_maps returned it.

name.description: The map's name, 1 to 120 characters of plain text.

style.description: The basemap style. Defaults to liberty.

position.description: Where the marker is, as [longitude, latitude]: longitude first.

description.description: At most 1000 characters of plain text; line breaks allowed.

view.description: The opening view and zoom limits. Leave it out to open on the markers.

center.description: The opening centre, as [longitude, latitude]: longitude first.

minZoom.description: The furthest out a viewer may zoom. Defaults to 0.

maxZoom.description: The furthest in a viewer may zoom. Defaults to 20.

bounds.description: [west, south, east, north] a viewer may not pan beyond, holding the centre and every marker.

navigation.description: Zoom and compass buttons. Defaults to true.

scale.description: A scale bar. Defaults to true.

cooperativeGestures.description: Require two fingers or a modifier key to move the map. Defaults to false.

publish.description: Publish the change. Defaults to true.

tools.name: publish_map
tools.title: Publish a map
tools.description: Publishes the map's current draft as its next release. Every embed and the page link show it within about a minute.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

id.description: The map's id, as create_map or list_maps returned it.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.title: List a map's releases
tools.description: Lists every release the map was published as, newest first: each one's number, state, style and when it was published and last made live.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

id.description: The map's id, as create_map or list_maps returned it.

tools.name: rollback_map
tools.title: Roll a map back
tools.description: Makes an earlier release of the map live again: its page link and every embed show it within about a minute. The draft is left as it is. Returns the release now live.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

id.description: The map's id, as create_map or list_maps returned it.

release.description: The number of the release to make live, as list_releases gave it.

expectedActive.description: The release you expect to be live now; the rollback is refused if another is. Defaults to the one live when the tool is called.

tools.name: withdraw_map
tools.title: Withdraw a map
tools.description: Takes a map down for good: its page link and every embed stop showing it, and it leaves the workspace. It cannot be undone.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

id.description: The map's id, as create_map or list_maps returned it.

tools.name: list_activity
tools.title: List activity
tools.description: Lists the workspace's 50 most recent events, newest first: what was done, to what, by whom, and when.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

tools.name: invite_person
tools.title: Invite a person
tools.description: Invites a person you are working for into the workspace by their email address, and returns link: give it to them in this conversation. Nothing is emailed. They open it signed in to SnapHop Maps with that address -- signing up first if they have no account -- and join with the role given. While someone who joined remains, the account is not deleted for inactivity. The link is shown this once; invite again for a new one, which replaces it.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

role.description: What they may do: ADMIN everything you can, members included; EDITOR create, change, publish and withdraw maps; VIEWER read only.

tools.name: list_invitations
tools.title: List invitations
tools.description: Lists the invitations nobody has accepted yet, newest first: each one's id, email, role and when it expires. The links are not shown again.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

tools.name: revoke_invitation
tools.title: Revoke an invitation
tools.description: Stops an invitation nobody has accepted yet: its link no longer works.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

id.description: The invitation's id, as list_invitations gave it.

tools.name: list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: Lists the workspace's members, you included: each one's userId, accountType, email (a person's), displayName, role and when they joined.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

tools.name: remove_member
tools.title: Remove a member
tools.description: Removes a person from the workspace at once. When the last person leaves, the account is again deleted after the inactivity period without a request, counted from then.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.

userId.description: The member's userId, as list_members gave it.

tools.name: replace_key
tools.title: Replace the API key
tools.description: Issues a new API key with the same scopes and a new expiry. Call it before the key expires: the account has no password and no other way back in. Returns the new apiKey, shown this once. The key given keeps working until the new one is first used, which stops it, so if this answer is lost, call it again with the same key.

apiKey.description: The key register_agent returned. Leave it out when the client sends it as an Authorization bearer header.
